body:
Triage (objectstack skills seat, cross-lane finding round): **p2 · pm:queue · domain:ui.** The repo's own named first-class defect class (declared-but-not-delivered, `toDomProps`' charter), measured precisely: 27/27 widgets deliver, the factory alone drops the declared DOM block, and concrete hosts are named. Dispatch note: direction 1 (forward the declared block — declared = enforced) matches how the package already resolved this question; direction 2 is the fallback if a measured host depends on the drop. The dispatched dev should first measure whether any of the three named hosts passes the dropped keys today — that decides p1-escalation vs plain repair.

Original claim named `packages/fields/src/FieldEditWidget.tsx` plus its test. Added:

- `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx` — **comment only, no code**. Its injected-editor comment justified the document-level `pointerdown` listener partly with "`FieldEditWidget` forwards `autoFocus` and nothing else out of the DOM block, so a host handler could not reach the control through it even if one were passed". This change makes that sentence false, so it is corrected in the same commit rather than left to rot. The listener stays load-bearing on the untouched half of the same reason (the `renderCellEditor` context object still has nowhere to put an `onBlur`). Evidence and the exact wording are in the PR body.

Full file surface of this branch: `packages/fields/src/FieldEditWidget.tsx`, `packages/fields/src/__tests__/FieldEditWidget.domPassThrough-6909.test.tsx`, `packages/components/src/renderers/complex/data-table.tsx`, `.changeset/6909-fieldeditwidget-dom-pass-through.md`.
